about: B2s/B3s sacred props for the walk-in interiors (contract 11, design 11.2). Each GLB is standalone: KTX2 textures (KHR_texture_basisu; albedo ETC1S sRGB, normal/ORM UASTC+Zstd), glTF +Y up, metres, the object's front faces +Z (glTF) and its origin is at the bottom centre (statues: base on the floor/plinth; wall pieces: bottom edge, back against the wall at z = 0). <name>_phone.glb is the phone LOD with 512 px maps (glass: half size). Materials named M_pbr_<set> carry only a fallback colour + metre UVs: bind pbrLibrary.getPbrSet(<set>) at load. Sources and licences: docs/designs/village-lots-v2/tools/sacred/SOURCES.md.
gpuMB: texture GPU memory with mips (1 byte/texel), shared by every instance of the same GLB
